scripts.build: node scripts/validate-env.mjs && node scripts/check-production-release.mjs source && node scripts/check-ad-funnel-release.mjs source && astro build && node scripts/check-ad-funnel-release.mjs dist
scripts.release:production: npm run build && npm run release:verify && node scripts/deploy-production.mjs && node scripts/check-live-ad-funnel.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write package.json scripts netlify/functions tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check package.json scripts netlify/functions tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.lint: eslint scripts netlify/functions tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.test:release: node scripts/check-public-safety.mjs && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs && node scripts/check-redirects.mjs && node scripts/i18n-validate.mjs --strict
scripts.test:qa: node scripts/check-public-safety.mjs && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs && node scripts/check-redirects.mjs && node scripts/i18n-validate.mjs --strict && node scripts/audit-visible-language.mjs fr
scripts.i18n:strict: pnpm run build && pnpm run i18n:audit:full && pnpm run i18n:audit:layout && pnpm run i18n:validate:strict
